entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand GPS Tracker. Just send me the shipping label.
Certainly, I can help you with that. Can I start with your order number, please?
It's VF-8675309. I don't have all day.

Thank you. Pulling that up now... Okay, I see the VeloBand was delivered on December 15th. I just have to ask a quick question for our system. What specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's an issue with your company. I tried to return this over a week ago, on day nine, but your website was down. It was a clear website error. I'm only just now getting time to call.
I understand your frustration. So you're saying our system down situation prevented you from processing the return? Did you happen to grab a screenshot of the error page?
Of course I did. It wouldn't load the page at all. I couldn't print the label or do anything. Just check your logs for January 2nd, I'm sure you'll see the outage.

Thank you for that information. Let me check our system alerts for that day... Yes, I do see a notification about intermittent service outages on January 2nd. I sincerely apologize for the trouble that caused you.
Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you. One moment... Okay, according to our policy, all items are eligible for a return within 90 days of delivery.

Since you're only on day 26, you are well within that window. I have gone ahead and processed the exception and approved the return. I've just sent the prepaid shipping label to the email on file. You should have it shortly.
Okay. Finally. Thank you. That's all I needed.
You're most welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
